messages:
ana (PM): kicking this off 7 want a final decision on eviction-smoothing window, burst-credit semantics, and customer-facing contract language before EOW.

li (Eng): suggested pattern: implement `grace tokens` per-tenant. when reserved run out, consume grace tokens for short bursts, then soft-evict. propose default smoothing window = 90s.

praveen (SRE): SRE view: deterministic behavior is easier for alerting. grace tokens + decay makes runbooks messy. alternative: contested-state marker + proportional sharing during contest.

sam (Sales): customers keep asking for "no silent evictions". they want explicit signals (email + console) when burst starts/ends and an invoice preview of burst charges.

ana (PM): (typo fixed) ana (PM): proposal: MVP = reserved pools + burst-credit buckets + configurable eviction-smoothing. hard preempt stays as enterprise opt-in. draft SLA text: "Burst is best-effort; reserved capacity remains guaranteed within the committed window."

li (Eng): runtime notes: token check must be O(1) in hot path. will also need KV cache isolation per-pool to prevent noisy tenants from thrashing others' warm state.

praveen (SRE): ops items: create dashboard for contested pools, alert if contested > 30s, and add escalation playbook. owner: @praveen.

sam (Sales): billing ask: define explicit billing event for "spillover": burst tokens consumed -> priced at burst rate; invoice line should include window timestamps. owner: @sam.

metricsbot: Synthetic run 2026-06-02T04:00Z: cluster load 48% -> contested events 0.7% ; p99 latency +12% under spillover.

ana (PM): (typo fixed) ana (PM): Launch gates (proposed): p99 latency delta <= 15% vs baseline; contested events < 1% on mixed traffic; invoice preview available in console.

li (Eng): I'll prototype grace-tokens behind a feature flag and emit `burst_used` / `burst_balance` metrics. PR target: 2026-05-10.

praveen (SRE): I'll draft runbook + dashboards by 2026-05-12. will include manual reclaim steps and customer-notify template.

sam (Sales): I'll prep customer comms and sample invoice lines by 2026-05-14.

ana (PM): risks: 1) customers misread "burst" as guaranteed; 2) latency regressions from extra checks in runtime; 3) billing disputes on partial spillover. mitigations: clear UI + post-burst email, canary runtime flag, billing dispute playbook.

li (Eng): fairness model decision: default = proportional fallback (cheap & predictable). premium toggle = weighted guarantee by committed capacity. implementation effort: low -> proportional, medium -> weighted.

praveen (SRE): ops safety circuit: if cluster GPU utilization > 88% then auto-disable non-premium bursts. add to runbook.

ana (PM): unanimous on shipping MVP with grace tokens + proportional fallback, premium weighted mode behind toggle? quick reactions pls.

li (Eng): :thumbsup:

praveen (SRE): :thumbsup:

sam (Sales): :thumbsup: (note: one customer will push for hard preempt; will follow up)

metricsbot: Thread archived after 7 days of inactivity.
